### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581`.

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `25ce9be612a10121abc2d5548d9c94ad694f6ce0` — the merge of head `76bd4fd39939e7e1f4523e6e36d2b3c99c35fd43` into base `ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 25ce9be612a10121abc2d5548d9c94ad694f6ce0 && git checkout 25ce9be612a10121abc2d5548d9c94ad694f6ce0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581 76bd4fd39939e7e1f4523e6e36d2b3c99c35fd43 && git checkout -B drift-repro ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581 && git merge --no-ff 76bd4fd39939e7e1f4523e6e36d2b3c99c35fd43

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ca135dcc40b898b39676012968784b09e5e56581` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aa115f1c60d416245c2f94a58e53d6ffdb4b19d9`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #22306 (body; 6062616189, 6072391543, 6074105698), #16344 (ruling 5582066157, landing 5614013523, its changeset at `d2c1d19807`), #6339, #14259 (ruling 5511947941), #15964 (ruling, batch #54), `origin/main` `e75dceddd7` (`engine.ts`, `rule-validator.ts`, `plugin.ts`, `hook.zod.ts`, the three changeset gates, `pre.json`), PR #22413 body, file list and the net diff `11d119ab18..aa115f1c60` (identical to `origin/main...head`; `main` has not moved on any of the 8 files), and the head's check-runs. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Hook input on a non-system create.** A caller-supplied value for a key in `staticReadonlyInsertSubject` (author-declared `readonly`, not runtime-owned, not on a `sys_` or platform-internal object) is no longer on `beforeInsert`'s `ctx.input.data`; the hook is shown the field's `defaultValue` or no key. **Right** — #16344's invariant applied. The hide (`withholdInsertReadonlyFromHooks`) and the post-hook strip (`staticReadonlyCreateStrip`) call the same `stripReadonlyFields` over the same subject with the same `suppliedPerRow[i]` snapshot and no `preserveAudit` option. The snapshot is taken after the write middleware (`#21682`), so the pre-hook no-record fallback `Object.is(row[k], supplied[k])` holds on every caller key: hide set = caller keys of the subject; strip set = the same minus `hookWrittenKeys`, and the hand-back restores every non-hook-written key to its caller value before the strip runs. **Hidden-but-stored: none.** The one channel that could produce one, `seedReplay` (`plugin.ts:1289`, keyed deliberately not on `isSystem`), has a single producer, `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` (`isSystem: true`), so it is outside the hide today. **Shown-but-stripped: one named set** — under `preserveAudit` the four `AUDIT_PROVENANCE_FIELDS` are shown and are then taken by the create strip unless the audit binder reinstates them (`plugin.ts:1289/1291/1313/1316`): a bare engine without `ObjectQLPlugin`, or `created_by`/`updated_by` with no `session.userId`. The PR's own `preserveAudit` pin is that bare engine and asserts the sighting only, not the store. Bounded by a server-constructed flag; acceptable, and the PR body's "the two cannot disagree" is overstated by exactly this edge.
2. **Stored outcomes.** Unchanged, except (i) the hotcrm shape now stamps — the fix; (ii) the self-assignment laundering route closes. **Right** in direction. Precision: `data.x = data.x` on a withheld key with no default writes `undefined`, is undone, handed back, stripped and reported (pinned on `closed_at`); on a withheld key WITH a `defaultValue` it is a hook write of the default (`handBackWithheldInsertReadonly`, third case; `stripReadonlyFields` keeps a hook-written key silently), so the default is stored and nothing is reported. The changeset's and PR body's sentence "the caller's value is still stripped and reported" is **false for the defaulted shape**; the engine docblock states the rule correctly. Not pinned.
3. **`strictReadonlyWrites`.** A self-assigning `beforeInsert` hook on a no-default withheld key used to launder the forgery into a 201; it is now refused 400. A public-door verdict change, the same one #16344 declared on update. **Right**, and BREAKING to declare (see ②).
4. **The explained fault.** A hook or sandboxed body reaching through a withheld object key (`ctx.input.data.meta.who = …`) used to answer 201 with `meta` stripped; it now answers 400 `HookWithheldReadonlyFaultError` naming the key. **Right** in direction (#16344's "sharpest edge"), BREAKING to declare. The `beforeInsert` prescription names `defaultValue`, never `ctx.previous`; the update message is byte-identical (the diff adds an insert branch ahead of `const message` and touches no update line).
5. **Placement before the defaults.** For an honest caller nothing is withheld: `hookViewSource[i]` keeps the row's reference, and `payloadRows`, `resolveDefaultPermissions` and `applyFieldDefaults` see the rows they saw before. A forging caller's hook sees the default — the honest view, unchanged. `insertShown` is captured from `defaultedData` before the recorder arms and before any hook mutates. **Right.**
6. **Hand-back.** After the seal, never over a hook write (`hookWrittenKeys` has the key → kept; no record → the #5591 value test against `shown`); `undefined` is never stored (present-and-undefined is deleted, handed back, then taken by the strip). **Right.** One asymmetry recorded: with no record (a hook replaced the payload object) a self-assigned default IS handed back and reported; with a record it is not.
7. **The three narrowings.** (1) `autonumber` stays visible — **right as scoped**: `staticReadonlyInsertSubject` (`rule-validator.ts:2381`) already excludes runtime-owned fields, #6339's pin and #14259's seam require the sighting, and the insert/update asymmetry is recorded in the acceptance notes; the rule is half-applied there by a prior ruling, not by this card. (2) The audit timeline under `preserveAudit` — **as wide as the channel needs**: the binder reinstates all four under the flag; not wider in keys (a business `readonly` column is still withheld — pinned), wider only in audience (every hook sees them, not only the binder), which one hook view cannot avoid. (3) `sys_` and platform-internal (`PLATFORM_INTERNAL_MANAGED_BUCKETS`) objects — **confirmed** outside the subject at `rule-validator.ts:2381`.
8. **Entry points (M3), by `git grep` on the head.** `triggerHooks('beforeInsert'` has one dispatch site, `engine.ts:13618`, inside the explaining wrapper; the only computed-event dispatcher is `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks(event: 'beforeUpdate' | 'beforeDelete')`. `insertMany` is `this.insert(…, __partialRowErrors)`. The protocol's single, batch and upsert-create arms call `engine.insert` (`protocol.ts:13629, 13723, 15059, 15070, 15388`). Seeds write with `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` (`isSystem: true`). **Confirmed.**
9. **Pins.** The 13 cases test the subject: ordering with a writable-key control, the hotcrm shape, a default shown in place of a forgery, the autonumber / system-writer / strip-report / strict-refusal controls, the no-default self-assignment, batch, `insertMany`, `preserveAudit`, the explained fault, an update control. Re-deriving the reported ablation by reading (`hookViewSource[i] = hidden.row` disabled): cases 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 go red and 4, 5, 7, 13 stay green — 9/4 as reported, and the four are the hide-independent controls. No pin is vacuous; the `preserveAudit` pin asserts sightings only (noted in 1). The three pins that went red in the first attempt (`engine-insert-runtime-owned-strip.test.ts`, `engine-hook-provenance-sibling-seams.test.ts`) are not in the diff — **kept unweakened**.
10. **Docs.** `hook.zod.ts`: no non-comment line changes (TSDoc only; the `submitted` describe is unchanged), and the new text is true — but `packages/spec` ships its sources, so this TSDoc publishes in the declarations (the #16344 thread's own lesson). `security.mdx` rule 5 and the callout — true. `system-context.mdx` — counts regenerated 118 → 119 (behaviour-bearing 115 → 116); the commit after the suites (`975f4b6690..head`) touches only this page. Not made false, but now incomplete: `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx:184-188` states the persist-image rule for update only, describing an asymmetry that no longer exists (the #16344 F3 cross-reference site) — one line owed; census row 21's "one gate over BOTH create-side passes" now sits beside a second `isSystem` read, the hide's — one clause owed. The `preserveAudit` describe (`execution-context.zod.ts:441` and its generated copies) and `protocol.mdx`'s "the strip runs after the `beforeInsert` hooks" stay true: the strip did not move.

### ② Semver level

**Wrong — FAIL.** The changeset grades `'@objectstack/objectql': patch` and declares a bare `Clause-②: no`. The diff is a declared narrowing and, under the repo's rules, owes `minor` with the BREAKING carriers.

- **The act.** What a `beforeInsert` handler reads on `ctx.input.data` changes for every hook author on a non-`isSystem` create. Three handler shapes lose a value they could read: deriving from it (the defect), reporting a forged key (now blind — and a create has no `ctx.submitted`, the member #16344's ruling refused to land without on update), and self-assignment (laundering closed; `strictReadonlyWrites` now refuses). A body or hook dereferencing through a withheld key flips 201 → 400 at the REST door. The PR itself rewrote two shipped sentences in `packages/spec` because they became false: a published statement of the contract moved.
- **The precedent is not what the dev's recommendation says.** #16344's changeset (`.changeset/hook-input-is-the-persist-image.md` at `d2c1d19807`) grades `@objectstack/objectql: minor`, and the subject of its `**BREAKING**` banner is "what a `beforeUpdate` handler reads on `ctx.input.data` changes" — not the new member, which the same text calls "new and optional", nor the plugin-auth migration, which it grades `patch`. The ruling's own words (5582066157): the banner is owed because "the meaning of `ctx.input.data` in `beforeUpdate` changes for every hook author". The breaking part of the precedent is the act this PR repeats on insert; "the handlers were deriving from a value that was never stored" was equally true on update and did not make it a `patch`.
- **The rule text.** `AGENTS.md:1076`: the declaration is `Clause-②: yes|no` plus at most one arm, and "`(narrowing)` is BREAKING". `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (`CLAUSE2_ARMS`, maintainer ruling #16421, 2026-09-07): "`no (narrowing)` — NOT a widening, but breaking. This is the whole point of the arm"; the arm exists because #16296, a narrowing, "shipped to consumers with every gate green" on a bare `no`. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs:1640`: a `no (narrowing)` carries the LEVEL axis, and "during the launch window a breaking change ships `minor`". `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (`breakingDeclaration`): the narrowing arm is a breaking signal and demands a disposition marker. `pr-automation.yml` WHICH LEVEL: breaking-ness is carried by the BREAKING banner plus the ADR-0087 disposition, not by the level. A bare `no` with `patch` is the #16296 shape exactly.
- **Pre mode.** `.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, tag `next`: the no-major guard stands aside for `major` only; the level, arm, banner and disposition rules apply unchanged. No sentence in the PR or changeset claims pre mode is absent.
- **`Clause-②: no` as the VALUE is right**: no key, no export, `hook.zod.ts` TSDoc-only with the `submitted` describe unchanged. The missing ARM and the level are what is wrong.
- **Exact change owed, in `.changeset/22306-insert-readonly-withheld-from-before-insert.md`:** (1) frontmatter `'@objectstack/objectql': minor`; (2) the declaration line, in the changeset body AND the PR body, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; (3) a `**BREAKING**` paragraph naming what a `beforeInsert` handler reads on `ctx.input.data` on a non-system create, the hidden set (`staticReadonlyInsertSubject`'s, minus the two stated edges), and the two door-visible flips (the strict refusal and the explained 400); (4) one ADR-0087 disposition marker in the HTML-comment form the gate reads, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) …`, as #16344's changeset carries it; (5) correct the self-assignment sentence to the engine's own rule (no default: undone, stripped, reported; with a `defaultValue`: kept as a hook write of the default, not reported). Ride-along, optional: name `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, since its shipped TSDoc moved.
- **False sentences:** the self-assignment sentence (changeset and PR body) for a withheld key with a `defaultValue`; "the two cannot disagree" (PR body), overstated by the `preserveAudit` shown-but-stripped edge. Everything else checked is consistent with the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions` (changeset level): answered — option B**, with the exact spelling in ②. Not escalated; the claim (6072391543) names the contract-tier review as the place this is settled.
- **Deviation: `preserveAudit` audit timeline stays visible** — accepted (①1, ①7).
- **Deviation: the hide runs before the defaults** — accepted (①5).
- **Deviation: files beyond the stated surface** (`hook-withheld-readonly-fault.ts` and test, `hook.zod.ts`, `security.mdx`, `system-context.mdx`) — accepted; each is true. `hook.zod.ts` is in `packages/spec`, which ships: the lane's standing routing rule for `packages/spec` applies as written; recorded here, no label or route written by this review.
- **Deviation: `origin/main` merged in** — fine; `main` has not moved on the 8 files since the merge-base.
- **Deviation: REST door measured as the seeded admin** — accepted; a non-system principal is what the gate reads, and the base call's strip firing shows the gate was live.
- **Deviation: model-free trailers / AGENTS.md footer** — reporting-only, per `AGENTS.md`.
- **Out-of-scope finding (autonumber asymmetry, carrier none)** — recorded; it is #6339's pin and #14259's seam, a decision of its own. Not escalated.
- **Not raised by the dev, named here for the next reader:** `seedReplay` is keyed "not on `isSystem`" by design (`plugin.ts:1289`) while the hide is `isSystem`-gated. Its only producer is system today; a future non-system `seedReplay` producer would make a withheld `created_at` hidden-but-stored. No action owed on this PR.
- **Docs owed (Low; may ride with the changeset fix):** one line at `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx:184` extending the persist-image sentence to insert; one clause on census row 21.
- **CI, read once at 2026-10-09T04:30Z on this head:** 41 check-runs — 36 success, 4 skipped (Auto Label, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke; none required), 1 in progress. Required contexts: TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Lint & Repo Gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate (and its 1/3, 2/3, 3/3) — all success. `Test Core`: shards 2/6 through 6/6 success; **`Test Core (1/6)` was still running when this was posted — a red on it is this PR's own.** Commit status: success. No red check at posting time; the FAIL above is ②'s, not CI's.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1c13a9930bff8196911ce362937ddb6337b327f4`
Local-runs: none

Re-review of the patch round, superseding 6074329758 (FAIL on ② at `aa115f1c60`). Inputs: the same set as before, plus dev report 6074595303, the rewritten PR body, and the net diff `11d119ab18..1c13a9930b`. `git diff --stat aa115f1c60..1c13a9930b`: three files, 36(+)/15(−), all text — `.changeset/22306-insert-readonly-withheld-from-before-insert.md` (`bf7071210b`), `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (`1c13a9930b`). `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, both fault files, `hook.zod.ts`, `security.mdx` and the 13-case pin file are byte-identical to the head I reviewed: **no code or test moved.** Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

The code is unchanged, so the ten judgments in 6074329758 stand on this head without re-derivation; the verdicts, restated: the hide and the strip take the same caller keys (same `stripReadonlyFields`, same `staticReadonlyInsertSubject`, same post-middleware `suppliedPerRow` snapshot, no `preserveAudit`) — **right**; hidden-but-stored: none (`seedReplay`'s only producer is `isSystem`); shown-but-stripped: the four `AUDIT_PROVENANCE_FIELDS` under `preserveAudit` when no binder reinstates them — accepted and now **stated in the PR body**; placement before the defaults leaves the honest caller's view unchanged — **right**; the hand-back runs after the seal, never over a hook write, never stores `undefined` — **right**; the three narrowings (`autonumber` visible, audit timeline under `preserveAudit`, `sys_`/platform-internal already outside the subject) — **right as scoped**; M3 single dispatch site — **confirmed**; the 13 pins test the subject, 9/4 under the reported ablation with the 4 as hide-independent controls, the three earlier-red pins untouched — **confirmed**; the update fault message byte-identical — **confirmed**.

What this round changed in the prose, judged against the engine:

1. **The self-assignment sentence** (changeset "What did not move", PR body "The change") now states the engine's two-shape rule: no `defaultValue` → the hook reads `undefined`, the write is undone, the caller's value is stripped and reported, `undefined` never stored; with a `defaultValue` → the hook re-assigns the default, counted as its write, the default stored, nothing reported. **True** — it is `handBackWithheldInsertReadonly`'s first and third cases and `stripReadonlyFields`'s silent keep of a hook-written key. (The no-record variant — a hook that replaced the payload object hands a self-assigned default back and reports — is an edge the sentence does not reach; acceptable in a changelog.)
2. **"The two cannot disagree"** is replaced in the PR body by the named `preserveAudit` shown-but-stripped edge (a bare engine without `ObjectQLPlugin`, or `created_by` / `updated_by` with no session user). **True**: `plugin.ts:1289/1291/1313/1316`.
3. **`hooks.mdx:187-189`**: "On a create the same value is withheld from `beforeInsert` too: the field holds its `defaultValue` or no key, and a create has no `ctx.submitted`." **True.**
4. **Census row 21**: "A second read in the same symbol gates the pass that withholds those caller values from `beforeInsert` before the strip, the same exemption, so a system caller's hook still sees what it sent." **True**: the hide is inside `ObjectQL.insert` under `if (!opCtx.context?.isSystem)`, the strip's own gate; a system writer's readonly value is shown and stored (pinned).

### ② Semver level

**Right — the changeset now says what the diff publishes, and so does the declaration.** Sentence by sentence against the diff and `origin/main`:

- Frontmatter `'@objectstack/objectql': minor` — the launch-window grade for a breaking change (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` header; `pr-automation.yml` WHICH LEVEL; `AGENTS.md:1076`). **Right**, and it matches #16344's grade for the same act on update.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — the ruled spelling for "not a widening, but breaking" (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, #16421). The VALUE is still right (no key, no export; `hook.zod.ts` is TSDoc-only with the `submitted` describe unchanged) and the ARM is now the fact the diff carries. The PR body's line 2 reads the same string, so the LEVEL axis reads it: `Check Changeset` re-ran at 05:00:53Z on the rewritten body and concluded success — a declared `no (narrowing)` with the moved package graded `minor`. **Right.**
- The ADR-0087 marker, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) …`, one marker, in the HTML-comment form the gate reads. The category's one mechanical check is that the body carries no migration prescription: the body states no FROM-TO mapping and no rename (the single arrow-shaped token in the file is the marker's own comment closer), and the disposition's reason is true — no authorable key, spelling, export or stored shape moves. `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on this head. **Right.**
- The `**BREAKING**` paragraph: "what a `beforeInsert` handler reads on `ctx.input.data` changes on a non-system create" — true; "ships as `minor` under the launch-window convention" — true, and no sentence claims pre mode is absent (`.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, tag `next`; the PR body says "pre mode stays on"). "What it reads now" (the `defaultValue` or no key) — true. "Which fields": `staticReadonlyInsertSubject`'s subject — author-declared `readonly: true`, not runtime-owned, outside `sys_` and the platform-internal `managedBy` buckets — true to `rule-validator.ts:2381`; the two edges (`autonumber` visible; the audit timeline under `preserveAudit`) — true. "Two answers at the REST door change": under `strictReadonlyWrites` a self-assigning hook's launder of a no-default withheld key answers 400 where it answered 201 — true (base: hook-written, spared, stored; head: undone, handed back, refused); a hook or body dereferencing through a withheld key answers 400 naming the field where it answered 201 — true (`dispatchHooksExplainingWithheldReadonly`). "A system-context create is unchanged" — true.
- "The defect" — unchanged from round 0, consistent with the pin file's header and the PR body's measured table.
- "What did not move" — the strip after the hooks and the hand-back: true; a hook's assignment stored: true (pinned); the self-assignment rule: true (①1); faults explained: true.
- "Who is affected" — the three handler shapes, including the honest statement that a reporting handler has no `ctx.submitted` on a create. True, and it is the sentence a third-party hook author needs.
- **`@objectstack/spec` not named.** Judged acceptable. The spec diff is TSDoc on `HookContextSchema` describing objectql's behaviour; it publishes in the declarations, but the fixed group versions in lockstep, so spec takes the same version either way, and no gate requires naming every package whose shipped bytes move (the LEVEL axis asks for at least one moved package at `minor`, which objectql is). Naming spec in THIS changeset would file objectql's BREAKING note under a spec `patch`, which misdescribes spec's own change; the alternative — a separate one-line spec `patch` changeset — is optional and not owed by a rule I can cite. The dev's reasoning holds.
- **False sentences:** none found in the changeset or the PR body on this head. The two I named in round 0 are corrected in both.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round-0 ② finding:** discharged in full — level, arm, banner, disposition, and the corrected sentence, in the changeset and the PR body.
- **Round-0 "Docs owed (Low)":** both landed in `1c13a9930b`; each true (①3, ①4).
- **Dev deviation — the preserveAudit pin asserts sightings, not the stored value; no test change this round:** accepted. The stored outcome for that edge is the strip's documented behaviour, pinned elsewhere; a store assertion on that pin would be a welcome follow-up, not a condition.
